sources.name: ArchDaily
sources.summary: The UNESCO World Heritage Committee has inscribed Aalto Works , a collection of thirteen buildings and architectural ensembles across Finland designed by Aino Marsio-Aalto, Elissa Aalto , and Alvar Aalto , on the UNESCO World Heritage List . The designation recognizes the international significance of a body of work that helped redefine modern architecture through a human-centered approach, emphasizing the relationship between buildings, everyday life, nature, and social well-being. Spanning projects completed between the late 1920s and the 1980s, the series represents Finland 's contribution to the Modern Movement while acknowledging the collaborative practice of the Aaltos and their studio.
sources.title: UNESCO Inscribes 13 Aalto Works on the World Heritage List

sources.name: Dezeen
sources.summary: UNESCO has updated its World Heritage List with 13 modernist buildings in Finland designed by architects Aino, Elissa, and Alvar Aalto. Collectively known as Aalto Works, the group of buildings is one of 25 sites added to this year's World Heritage List, which also included a collection of 10 significant modernist buildings in Tashkent.
